title: Creating MCP servers for Dynamics 365 Business Central with Azure Logic Apps.
summary: Azure Logic Apps Standard now supports Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, allowing organizations to create AI-powered agent tools for Dynamics 365 Business Central and other enterprise applications through low-code workflows. This integration enables seamless AI agent execution within integration platforms without complex orchestration layers.
key_points: MCP servers standardize how AI agents interact with external systems, and Azure Logic Apps Standard provides built-in connectors to create them for Business Central
Existing workflows can be converted into discoverable MCP tools that agents can call securely through low-code configuration
Authentication options include OAuth and key-based methods, with API keys generated for MCP server access
MCP servers can be used from AI client tools like GitHub Copilot to interact with Business Central data at scale
Multiple MCP tools can be shared across workflows and applications, reducing integration complexity

quotes.text: MCP servers maintain conversation history and contextual information across workflow executions, critical for stateful AI interactions.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights how MCP enables sophisticated AI interactions that remember context across multiple workflow runs
